name: dispatch-sentinel
description: Phase 12 productization tenant isolation for Dispatch Sentinel.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @dispatch-sentinel/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @dispatch-sentinel/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:api: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @dispatch-sentinel/api
scripts.typecheck:web: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @dispatch-sentinel/web
